name: dmctn-mcp
description: Auto-register local-coding-tools MCP and sync DMCTN-MCP Copilot agent for VS Code workspaces.

commands.title: DMCTN MCP: Setup Workspace (mcp.json + DMCTN-MCP agent)
DMCTN MCP: Show DMCTN-MCP Agent Selection Hint
DMCTN MCP: Verify MCP Server Build
DMCTN MCP: Mở bảng điều khiển

dmctnMcp.serverRoot.description: Absolute path to local-coding-tools-mcp (contains dist/server.js). Empty = auto-detect sibling folder in workspace.

dmctnMcp.autoSyncOnOpen.description: Sync .vscode/mcp.json and DMCTN-MCP agent files when a workspace opens.

dmctnMcp.showAgentHintOnOpen.description: Show a reminder to select the DMCTN-MCP Copilot agent after workspace sync.

dmctnMcp.autoApplyPolicyOnFirstRun.description: Lần đầu mở extension (hoặc khi nâng cấp policy) tự ghi DMCTN-MCP agent + copilot-instructions MCP_ONLY (87 tools) vào workspace.

dmctnMcp.serverVersion.description: MCP server version to install. Empty = use bundled server-manifest.json.

dmctnMcp.serverDownloadUrl.description: Override URL for customer ZIP download. Empty = use manifest GitHub Release URL.

dmctnMcp.autoBootstrapServer.description: Auto-download MCP server from Release ZIP when installing if not present locally.
